resources.string: K.T.O Kids AccessibilityService API disclosure explains Diagnostics, Other app performance data, Device or other identifiers, and Approximate location, plus Other actions, Web browsing history, Emails, Precise location, Crash logs, SMS or MMS messages, Name, Email address, Personal identifiers, Address, Phone number, and Other user-generated content. Parental control and child safety with parent consent. Approximate location, Precise location, and Crash logs are not collected via AccessibilityService API. Full in-app disclosure is shown before enabling this service.
